workarounds.symptom: @langchain/aws: convertBedrockConverseStream drops the reasoning block's signature on Bedrock Converse streaming
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(aws): preserve reasoning signatures in native stream events. Target files: libs/providers/langchain-aws/src/utils/stream_events.ts, libs/providers/langchain-aws/src/tests/chat_models_stream_events.test.ts, libs/providers/langchain-aws/src/utils/tests/stream_events.test.ts. `convertBedrockConverseStream` handles reasoning text but drops the separate signature delta sent by Bedrock. The assembled message therefore has no reasoning signature, and replaying it on the next turn can fail with `thinking.signature: Fie... (Ref: https://github.com/langchain-ai/langchainjs/pull/11905)

workarounds.symptom: ChatBedrockConverse streaming: text deltas drop `contentBlockIndex`, so thinking-mode responses aggregate into hundreds of text fragments — silently breaking Bedrock prompt caching
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(aws): preserve Bedrock stream content indices. Target files: libs/providers/langchain-aws/src/utils/message_outputs.ts, libs/providers/langchain-aws/src/utils/tests/message_outputs.test.ts, .changeset/quiet-beds-stream.md. - preserve Bedrock contentBlockIndex on streamed text deltas that follow another content block - allow LangChain indexed content merge to combine text deltas into a single block after reasoning - preserve the Bedrock reasoning signature through the same streamed reasoning-to-text sequence use... (Ref: https://github.com/langchain-ai/langchainjs/pull/11368)

workarounds.symptom: [@langchain/aws] ChatBedrockConverse throws "Member must not be null" on reasoningContent.reasoningText.text during multi-turn tool-call replay
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(aws): replay signed Bedrock reasoning with empty text. Target files: libs/providers/langchain-aws/src/utils/compat.ts, libs/providers/langchain-aws/src/utils/message_inputs.ts, libs/providers/langchain-aws/src/tests/chat_models.test.ts. Claude Sonnet 5 on Bedrock defaults to `display: "omitted"`, so its reasoning blocks are signed but have empty text. Since #11200, `ChatBedrockConverse` drops those blocks on replay, and Bedrock rejects the next tool-call turn with a 400. (Ref: https://github.com/langchain-ai/langchainjs/pull/12100)

workarounds.symptom: [@langchain/aws] ChatBedrockConverse never uses `this.caller`, so `maxRetries` and `onFailedAttempt` are silently ignored (they work in @langchain/openai)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(aws): use this.caller in ChatBedrockConverse to support retries. Target files: libs/providers/langchain-aws/src/chat_models.ts, libs/providers/langchain-aws/src/tests/chat_models.invocation.test.ts, libs/providers/langchain-aws/src/tests/chat_models.test.ts. Fixes an issue where `ChatBedrockConverse` bypassed `this.caller` and called `this.client.send(...)` directly, causing: 1. `maxRetries` (passed via constructor or call options) to be silently ignored during transient network/throttling errors. 2. `onFailedA... (Ref: https://github.com/langchain-ai/langchainjs/pull/11463)

workarounds.symptom: createAgent().streamEvents() inside a LangGraph node delivers config callbacks twice when LangSmith tracing is enabled
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(core): deliver callbacks once to a handler registered twice by merged configs. Target files: libs/langchain-core/src/callbacks/manager.ts, libs/langchain-core/src/callbacks/tests/manager.test.ts, libs/langchain/src/agents/tests/reactAgent.test.ts. Merging two runnable configs that both carry the same callback handler registered that handler twice, so it received every callback twice. A `createAgent().streamEvents()` run inside a LangGraph node with tracing on hits this: every streamed chunk arrives twice. . . (Ref: https://github.com/langchain-ai/langchainjs/pull/12026)
